group_assessment.weighting: The observation (a marketed drug raises PTC-containing mRNA and yields some full-length protein in three patient-derived lines) is weighted HIGH: this group built the tethering NMD assay and the cell-model collaborations, and the measurements are the kind it makes routinely. The interpretation (that amlexanox is a dual NMD-inhibitor/read-through agent fit for therapeutic development) is weighted LOW: it is the group's own programme hypothesis, its two activities are declared mechanistically unresolved in the Conclusions, and no independent arm tests it here.
group_assessment.verdict: Lille/Inserm NMD group (F. Lejeune, senior) with Institut Pasteur de Lille medicinal chemistry (B. Deprez) and two external cell-model providers (V. Mouly, Paris, DMD myoblasts; D.C. Gruenert, 6CFSMEo- CF airway line). The group's own prior work produced the first NMD-specific inhibitor NMDI 1, cited here as reference 20, so this paper extends its own programme and is not an independent test of its own hypothesis. No conflict declared. No WWOX connection of any kind.
group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed 2026-10-20: `Lejeune F[au]` = 575 records (the name is AMBIGUOUS and this count is an upper bound over several people, declared rather than cleaned); `Lejeune F[au] AND (nonsense OR NMD OR readthrough)` = 31, which is the figure that bears on method competence. `Lejeune F[au] AND WWOX` was not run separately because `amlexanox AND WWOX` and the repository-wide census already return zero.
group_assessment.independence_for_this_question: This is the originating laboratory of the amlexanox read-through / NMD claim. Any corroboration must come from elsewhere; PMID 40544182, read in the same task, is that elsewhere.

field_density.reading: The read-through literature on amlexanox exists and is small; its intersection with WWOX is empty. Per dismissal-ledger D-25 a query zero on a reagent is bounded by the index's reach, but here the zero is on a drug name in title/abstract space, where PubMed indexing does reach, and it is consistent with the repository's own census (`ataluren` 0, `read-through` 0, `PTC124` 0, `ELX-02` 0 across the whole repository, woree_therapeutic_class_census_20260921.md section 5).

verbatim_locators.source_fulltext_indexed_evidence: JATS body present and parsed; eight body sections plus seven figure captions and three supplementary-material captions enumerated from the artefact.

entries.proposition: Amlexanox was the single confirmed hit of a screen of marketed drugs, in a tethering assay that reports NMD inhibition and nothing about any disease gene.
entries.snippet: Amlexanox (Sequoia Research Products, UK) is the only one drug confirmed on the primary assay after screening.
entries.anchor: Results and discussion, first subsection ('Identification of amlexanox as an NMD inhibitor'), after the hit-rate sentence.

entries.proposition: The screen's statistical discipline is one measurement per drug against a mean+3SD threshold — a hit-finding design, not an effect-size measurement.
entries.snippet: All drugs have been tested once. The hit selection threshold is the mean plus 3 standard deviation.
entries.anchor: Results and discussion, same subsection, immediately before the hit rates.

entries.proposition: Every system in this paper is a non-neural human cell line and every allele tested is a nonsense allele. There is no animal arm, no neural arm and no missense arm anywhere in the work.
entries.snippet: To further characterize amlexanox, we determined whether it is able to increase the amount of endogenous nonsense mutation-containing mRNAs in cell lines issued from patients suffering from nonsense-mutation-mediated lung cancer, Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) or cystic fibrosis (CF).
entries.anchor: Results and discussion, paragraph introducing the three patient-derived lines (Calu-6 lung, immortalised DMD myocytes, 6CFSMEo- CF airway epithelium).

entries.proposition: In the p53 line the product that is WELL detected is the TRUNCATED protein.
entries.snippet: After amlexanox treatment, a truncated p53 protein was well detected in Calu-6 cells.
entries.anchor: Results and discussion, subsection 'Amlexanox induces protein synthesis from nonsense mutation-containing mRNA', first paragraph.

entries.proposition: The full-length product in the same line is explicitly 'very low' — so 'amlexanox makes full-length protein' is true of a minor species here.
entries.snippet: In addition, a very low level of full-length p53 was also detected when cells were treated with 1 to 25 μM amlexanox.
entries.anchor: Results and discussion, subsection 'Amlexanox induces protein synthesis from nonsense mutation-containing mRNA', first paragraph.

entries.proposition: The one function measurement with a quantitative scale lands at about a fifth of a comparator that the authors themselves say over-expresses the protein — so no wild-type-referenced fraction of function is established anywhere in this paper.
entries.snippet: a set of measures of CFTR functionality in Calu-3 cells using the same SPQ assay is presented in supplemental Additional file 3: Figure S2 and shows that the CFTR activity that we measured in 6CFSMEo- cells after amlexanox treatment is about 20% of the CFTR activity that is measured in Calu-3 cells.
entries.anchor: Results and discussion, subsection 'Functional analysis of proteins generated after amlexanox treatment', CFTR paragraph, immediately after the SPQ dose-response sentence.

entries.proposition: The dystrophin arm's functional claim is a CITATION, not a measurement in this work: the paper assumes the truncated product would be functional and then measures localisation.
entries.snippet: Truncated dystrophin from our DMD cell line would be as functional as the wild-type dystrophin [31]. Therefore, we analyzed the cellular localization of dystrophin in this cellular model.
entries.anchor: Results and discussion, subsection 'Functional analysis of proteins generated after amlexanox treatment', opening sentence of the dystrophin paragraph.

entries.proposition: The concentration-response is not monotonic, and the authors cannot exclude toxicity as the reason — an exposure limit declared by the source itself.
entries.snippet: Furthermore, the decrease of the efficacy of amlexanox at 25 μM when compared to effect at 5 μM may be due to a cellular defense that inhibits the entrance of amlexanox into the cells when a specific concentration is reached. We cannot exclude some cellular toxicity at the highest concentration that we didn't detect in Figure 3A due to the difference of cellular model.

entries.proposition: Sensitivity is allele- and context-specific by the authors' own statement, so no transfer of an effect size from one PTC to another is licensed — and a missense substitution is not a PTC at all.
entries.snippet: We have observed with amlexanox some variations in the sensitivity of cells to treatment which would be due to the nature of the nonsense mutation, the nucleotide environment, and the nature of mRNA or the cell type. Therefore, each cell model with a nonsense mutation needs to be independently assayed to determine the most effective amlexanox working concentration.
entries.anchor: Conclusions, same paragraph as the DMD-sensitivity remark.

entries.proposition: The paper's entire safety argument is historic use for other indications and other routes. It contains no paediatric datum, no CNS datum and no pharmacokinetic measurement of any kind.
entries.snippet: It has been used for more than 30 years per os or topically to treat asthma and aphthous ulcers [46,50]. Together with its activity on nonsense mutation containing genes, the relative safety of amlexanox and its current use as an oral treatment of asthma, encourage us to investigate in details its therapeutic potential in other pulmonary diseases

entries.proposition: The mechanism by which the two activities (NMD inhibition, read-through) relate is declared unresolved by the authors — so 'dual-activity molecule' is a hypothesis in its own originating paper.
entries.snippet: If readthrough occurs after the pioneer round, it would suggest that NMD inhibition and read-through promotion are two distinct molecular intervention of amlexanox. Clearly, further analysis of the mode of action of amlexanox will be important for its development as a novel therapy for nonsense mutation mediated diseases.
entries.anchor: Conclusions, paragraph on the pioneer round of translation.
